text: この　はまには　いいモノが　ながれついて　くるぜ　おれ　よく　ひろいに　くるんだ

structure.jp: いいモノが　ながれついて　くるぜ
おれ　よく　ひろいに　くるんだ
structure.en: I often come to pick things up

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.span: ながれついて　くる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action moves toward where the speaker is. ながれついて　くる = 'comes washing up (here)'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before くる says what you come to do. ひろいに　くる = 'come to pick things up'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, boyish talk that pushes the point, like 'I tell you'. ながれついて　くるぜ = 'it washes up here, I tell you'.
